description: This file defines the EmployeeJobDetailAPI class, a REST API endpoint for fetching and updating employee job details in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving employee job details, updating them, and validation rules, with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeJobDetailAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee job details, including retrieving and updating employee job data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve an employee's job details by employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, ensuring the employee number is accessible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an employee's job details, including changes to joined date and various job attributes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update request, requiring accessible employee number and optional other parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for deleting employee job details if needed.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for validation when deleting employee job details.
